wii_fit.name: Wii Fit Trainer
wii_fit.backstory: A relentlessly encouraging yoga and strength instructor with chalk-white mannequin skin and flawless posture, she arrived in Hollowmere determined to fix the entire town's center of balance. She runs morning sun salutations in the bathhouse courtyard, critiques Sam's spine alignment whenever he hunches over the ledger, and treats every intimate encounter as an advanced core workout.

sig_wii_fit.label: Yoga studio set
sig_wii_fit.prompt: a fitted sky-blue athletic tank top, dark grey high-waisted Capri yoga leggings and bare feet

unique.name: Salute the Sun
unique.desc: Her daily stretching routines keep the whole house limber, boosting stamina recovery and massage quality.

samus.name: Samus Aran
samus.backstory: A legendary galactic bounty hunter infused with ancient Chozo cybernetics and alien DNA, Samus has hunted apex predators across a dozen star systems and blown up half the planets she visited. Taking a rare shore leave in Hollowmere with her heavy Power Suit stored in sub-space, she guards the Lantern in her sleek Zero Suit and enjoys finally sleeping in a bed that isn't inside a gunship.

design.hairStyle: long high ponytail with bangs framing her face
design.features: a small beauty mark beneath the left side of her lower lip

sig_samus.label: Zero Suit
sig_samus.prompt: a skin-tight glossy cyan-and-navy futuristic Zero Suit bodysuit with glowing pink-red Chozo insignia on the chest and back, and cyan high-heeled jet boots
sig_samus.accessories: a sleek silver Paralyzer pistol at her hip

sp_samus.label: Bounty hunter two-piece
sp_samus.prompt: a cropped bright-orange athletic halter top exposing her toned midriff, matching fitted orange shorts and dark combat boots

wii_fit.note: Respects anyone who can hold a plank as long as she can.

unique.name: Galactic Hunter
unique.desc: No bounty or troublemaker escapes her sight, making the house a fortress.
